contract.state: Poll controller.state() once per game frame; move.x is right, move.y is forward, length <= 1. Canvas games negate move.y.
contract.active: Pass active: () => gameplayIsRunning. Menus, hidden pages, focused text fields, blur, resize and orientation changes clear movement.
contract.gestures: Immediate stick displacement and WASD/arrows. No long-press or double-tap actions. Continuous movement stops on release/cancel.
contract.lifecycle: clear(), setEnabled(boolean), destroy(); destroy before replacing a controller.
contract.loading: The shared kit loads one local vendor script on first createInput; await the Promise before allowing play. Load failures reject.
contract.packaging: Ship assets/weyland-input.js beside assets/gg-mobile.js, including native/offline bundles. An inlined kit resolves it from assets/ beside the page.
contract.migration: New games use GG.createInput instead of local movement listeners or data-gg-keypad. Existing unmigrated games keep their controls.
